sermon.title: A Good Mother
sermon.speaker: Michael Silla
sermon.summary: A Mother’s Day message comparing good mothers to the church. Just as mothers nurture a child from conception to adulthood, the church—the bride and body of Christ—helps believers grow. A good mother won’t abort her children, and a good church won’t remove Jesus or taint the pure milk of the word; it calls for repentance and serves the least of these.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Delivered by a speaker other than Pastor Kincer (likely Michael Silla—confirm). Points to check: “Matthew 19:27” spoken for 1 Corinthians 12:27; “Matthew 25:35 36” text through 25:40; 8% of children without a mother and 5% without either parent; “19 percent” aborted, “one out of five kids”; 24,000 manuscripts. Sensitive content kept as spoken: a “big bat in your head” for anyone hurting his kids; a baby in heroin withdrawal; sex before marriage and same-sex relations “all wrong”; Americans doubting miracles and creation in six days.

faqs.question: Who is the author and finisher of our faith?
What is the goal for Christians?
What is the church according to the Bible?
faqs.answer: The bride and body of Christ.

faqs.question: What does Jesus say about serving the least?
faqs.answer: As you did it to them, you did it to me.

faqs.question: Is Jesus the only way to eternal life?
What should newborn Christians desire?
faqs.answer: The pure milk of the word.

faqs.question: Can you help your sin?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can change with God’s help.
